name: Alsco Uniforms
description: The pace of life might be slower in Casper than in other parts of the country, but its business owners still care about quality and customer service. That’s why many businesses in the greater Casper area, including Mills and Evansville, rely on Alsco Uniforms for their uniform rentals. As the company that started uniform rentals in the late 1800s, we set a high standard for quality and service. Our heavy-duty workwear uniforms for industrial and manufacturing sectors serve a dual purpose: they present a professional image and protect workers against environmental hazards. Our restaurant uniforms create a unified appearance that can be matched with table linens, enhancing the dining experience. For the healthcare sector, we offer a comprehensive range of uniforms, including scrubs and lab coats, tailored to meet specific needs. Alsco Uniforms also provides restaurant linens and hygienically clean bed linens to ensure a safe and welcoming environment for guests. In addition to uniforms and linens, we supply first-aid kits, washroom supplies, and a catalog of floorcare equipment and supplies—including both branded and non-branded floor mats—to support businesses in Casper and nearby areas.
